about_the_game:
Countless souls have been dragged into the depths of hell, forced to battle in a chaotic theater of doom for the twisted amusement of the Demons. With the promise of being given another chance, they ll fight countless enemies to see their loved ones once again.

Choose from a wild cast of bizarre fighters, arm yourself with an arsenal of outrageous weapons, and unleash devastating synergies as you face endless hordes of demonic foes.

Survive, reclaim your soul and return to the land of the living. Will you rise from the ashes, or will you become just another forgotten soul in the arena?

Features:

  • A diverse cast of quirky characters with unique playstyles

  • Fast-paced Survivor Roguelite action

  • Wide variety of crazy weapons and power-ups

  • Hordes of wacky enemies to

  • Unique synergy mechanics between weapons and abilities

  • Chaotic multiplayer mode (CO-OP)

  • And much more!

name: Cartoon Bash

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3-6100 3.7 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 660 Ti 2GB or similar
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Cartoon Bash is a horde survivor game where our dear protagonists who just died must fight to get another chance to get back to life. You equip multiple weapons and items, fighting off waves of enemies and bosses.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
